Name: StardewAI Assistant
Author: balibob
Description:
Stardew Valley AI Assistant is an intelligent in-game assistant powered by Google Gemini and OpenAI ChatGPT that answers all your Stardew Valley questions instantly! Simply press a key, type your question, and get accurate, context-aware answers sourced directly from the official Stardew Valley Wiki.

✨ Features
🧠 Multi-Model AI Support - Choose between Google Gemini (Free) or OpenAI ChatGPT for intelligent responses.
🎯 Game Context Awareness - The AI secretly reads your game state! It knows the current season, time, weather, location, your gold, health, and energy levels to give you personalized advice.
📜 Quest & To-Do Assistant - The AI reads your active Quest Log and helps you figure out exactly how to complete your current missions.
📚 Wiki-Based Knowledge - All answers are sourced from the official Stardew Valley Wiki for accuracy.
🌍 12 Languages Supported - Automatically detects your game language and responds accordingly (English, Türkçe, Deutsch, Español, Français, Italiano, 日本語, 한국어, Português, Русский, 中文, Magyar).
💬 Beautiful Chat Interface - Clean, scrollable chat window with message history.
⏳ Animated Typing Indicator - See when the AI is thinking.
🗑️ Clear Chat Button - One-click to clear conversation history.
⚙️ Settings Menu - Easily change your AI model, API key, and toggle key in-game (Press F8).
📋 First-Time Setup Guide - Easy step-by-step instructions to get your API key.

🎮 How to Use
Press G (default) to open the chat window.
Type your question and press Enter.
Get instant answers about crops, fishing, mining, NPCs, events, and your active quests!
You can easily switch between Gemini and ChatGPT right from the chat window!
Press F8 to access the settings menu.

📥 Installation
Install SMAPI (required).
Extract the mod to your Stardew Valley/Mods/Stardew Valley AI Assistant folder.
Launch the game - the setup wizard will guide you through getting a FREE API key.
That's it! Start asking questions!

💡 Example Questions
General Knowledge:

"How do I catch a legendary fish?"
"What gifts does Abigail like?"
"When is the Egg Festival?" Context-Aware (New!):
"I have 500g and low energy. What should I eat or buy?"
"Based on the current season and weather, what should I do today?"
- "Can you give me a step-by-step guide to complete my active quests?"
Enjoy your farming adventure with AI assistance! 🌾
